title: Pick the Hook
goal: Great games HOOK you in. Each thing in a game makes you feel something.
mascot_lines: A hook is the first thing someone sees in your game.
It has to grab them in just a few seconds — or they'll move on.
Good hooks are honest, not tricky. Lying makes people leave faster.
A hook can be a wow moment, a fun question, or just a really good first level.

tier2.rephrase: Each game feature makes the player feel a feeling. Match them up.

tier3.nudge: Power-ups make you feel POWERFUL. Surprises make you CURIOUS. Tough bosses make you PROUD when you win.
